procedure.candidate: Entire frozen lean4stage adaptive algorithm on outer_train only; source/archive frozen before any outer score

budget.setup: 600 source (including exact registered new outer contracts) +180 exact archive +120 materialization =900; no extra fixture phase silently added.
budget.agent: 2100/6000 include selected refit/CSV/stage receipts/cleanup; with existing90s wrapper reserve solver2010/5910. Requested inner HPO900/2100 must actually be available at its first worker with export+cleanup reserve.
budget.control: 180/1200 cover complete fixed recipe refit including all components/startup/export/source/cleanup. Timeout is failure, no cap increase. Optional exact candidate-control job reuse is preregistered below.
budget.final: 300 combined derived-inner procedure audit plus one outer judge;120 cleanup/power/source/report. Strict complete-phase admission; no retries, wall extension or reinvestment of unused historical/T7 time.

regression.rule: Original latest observation period, all strictly earlier fitting; use original pinned observation_values/time column, no target-driven cutoff

classification.rule: ORIGINAL typed feature-hash groups before CSV/subsetting/FE/resampling

outer_partition.group_semantics: Feature patterns are proxies, not verified independent people/entities; hash collision/conflicting labels possible.
outer_partition.row_mapping: Exhaustive disjoint sorted original zero-based train/outertest positions; original IDs and outer-test positions in judge-only vault. Require unique non-null IDs before and AFTER runtime parsing, exact bijection and no train/test ID overlap.

materialization.source_of_rows: Original train.csv only; original unlabeled test is schema/context metadata, never scored outer rows.
materialization.raw_lexical_rows: Prototype copies original CSV cells via csv.reader/writer, preserving row order/strings. Agent test excludes ALL target columns; no true outer target in sample_submission.
materialization.sample: V1 current value outputs: fixed0.0 regression or first declared class. R3 readback explicitly verifies EVERY placeholder value, ordered sample/test columns and exact ID dtype/value series; no heldout target data needed.
materialization.actual_reader: Re-read with exact frozen read_input_table/discover, default parser. Assert exact pandas dtype/value/NaN equality to original selected rows and same ordered uint64 feature hashes. No float tolerance/coercion/padding/reseed. Float formatting alone does not fix object-to-numeric subset inference.
materialization.raw_vs_derived: Keep original typed source hashes and actual derived-reader hashes separately; require equality by row mapping. Outer grouping comes from original, not rederived grouping after CSV changes.
materialization.failure: Any drift/infeasible classes/missingID/parsecollision/duplicateheader/missingrow/overflow yields explicit failure with null metrics and preserved partial files; no silent repair/repartition.
materialization.source_dialect: Freeze explicit delimiter from original trusted reader probe (, ; tab |). Lexical writer takes required source_delimiter and emits derived comma CSV; no blind comma assumption.
materialization.schema: All declared targets excluded from test/feature columns, unique bounded columns, expected original-position SHA checked before writes. Full driver must bind spec/raw source/indices to partition provenance.

agent_visible: exact protected recipe and flat allowlisted runtime
judge_only: precomputed expected derived inner split manifests
target_boundary.physical_vault: Outside every agent cwd/catalog/input manifest. Vault/raw original labels are handled by trusted materializer/judge roles only; algorithm contexts/specs/job paths use derived inputs exclusively.
target_boundary.process: Fresh solver processes receive ONLY derived task paths; never preload/carry original full train into solve_single task_data. Every nested worker/control subprocess must use derived spec paths.
target_boundary.unresolved: Trusted algorithm-facing source/I/O contract remains to be implemented/verified for agent+all nested workers: only derived task inputs/job paths/context, no original full-target/vault reads in algorithm. Trusted splitter may read targets for SGKF; trusted parent may hash source bytes. No adversarial OS/ACL security claim or extra permission is required.
target_boundary.task_text: Before any fit freeze deterministic derived task text preserving metric/roles/time semantics and file names; inspect for stale counts/period claims/full-target statistics. Do not inject heldout support/labels or reuse original task text blindly if inconsistent. Dictionary schema metadata may be copied only under that contract.

required_refs: Derived five input byteSHAs and actual parser dtype/value/hash parity receipt
Recomputed derived primary seed42/time latest; confirmation seed43/time offset1; actual nested HPO seed137 partitions, exact dtype/shape/ordered arraySHAs
Mappings from derived rows back to original outer_train; assert every inner job row belongs to outer_train and no outer validation row enters any fit/metric/decision

Actual EDA before firstfit; protected exact ensemble+SINGLE; successful broad+CatBoost32/original protection; learner families; actual HPO requested/full budget/trials; chosen recipe/iterationtree/refit/CSV/IDs/class/proba/usage/cleanup/source
derived_inner_audit.old_R4: Use frozen R4 manual metric/artifact/stage formulas as source reference only. Its historical full-train split refs, baseline comparability, global plan/root paths cannot be copied; do not compare different derived inner cuts to historical V16 means as if same partition.
derived_inner_audit.known_reuse: Regression outer_train ends one period earlier: inner HPO latest may equal confirmation again. Both remain adaptive inner evidence; outer labels alone are withheld. History_min_periods3 may become infeasible; record actual behavior/failure, never weaken frozen control.

fixed_strong_control.iteration_tree: Derive only from OWN completed protected control primary+confirmation fit_iterations using unchanged frozen median_iterations; preserve complete ensemble tree. Freeze before any outer label. Never borrow selected candidate/HPO iterations or outer scores.
fixed_strong_control.fresh_full_refit: Run exact control full_fit=True on same derived input files/source/spec with that tree; retain jobs/results/test caches/CSV/identity/closure proofs. No historical prediction/model reuse.
fixed_strong_control.conditional_reuse: Only if candidate final job exact complete control recipe, same full_fit/data/source/iteration tree/effective parameters/seed/export class mapping/ID order matches planned control job. Pin preregistered predicate and byte refs before labels; otherwise perform reserved real control refit. No score-dependent reuse.
fixed_strong_control.iteration_source_failure: Missing/failed own inner protected control receipts means unqualified whole comparison, not fallback iterations or zero metric.

prelabel_seal.independent_parent: Seal BOTH tasks candidate/control selected recipes, effective params, full iteration trees, all final jobs/results/predictionCSV+NPZ, raw/derived inputs, row/split/class order, source/archive/evaluator, inner audits and fresh exact owner closure BEFORE judge opens targets.
prelabel_seal.pending_prototype: R3 helper validates per-task actual SHA/clock metadata, canonicalizes refs from explicit work_root, rejects conflicting digests for same path, verifies byte inventory, returns authorizes_label_read=False. It cannot replace semantic inner/control/closure/algorithm-I/O validation and once-only numeric judge.
prelabel_seal.receipts: Raw access/closure/roundtrip/inner-proof metadata must be independently semantically verified; an availability/cleanup boolean alone is insufficient.
prelabel_seal.labels_open_once: Exactly one judge invocation after complete seals. Keep raw once-only failure/timeout; no recipe/weight/calibration/threshold/control/tree/partition choice after any outer score.
prelabel_seal.IO_roles: algorithm_label_access_attempts_before_seal counts agent/fit/control-worker attempted label reads only. Splitter original-target stratification and parent byte hashing are distinct trusted roles, not forbidden algorithm access.

numeric_judge.RMSE: Manual sqrt(mean((truth-pred)^2)) over exact original heldout row mapping; finite numeric values.
numeric_judge.MacroF1: ALL declared10 classes, exact output/class cache order, complete confusion matrix and zero_division0; include classes with no predicted positives. Never drop rare classes to fit a bound.
required_integrity: Candidate/control IDs map exactly once to original heldout positions
Submission+NPZ class order/probability rows/finite/normalization and CSV-roundtrip agree
Original pristine target vault SHA/source IDs/partition still match seal
Both prediction producers terminal and all guarded source/input files unchanged before/after score
Judge completion/cleanup/report within original absolute wall+mono deadline
numeric_judge.additional_diagnostics: Freeze supported-class set/rarest using original OUTER FITTING feature-pattern group counts only (threshold100, deterministic tie bylabel). Per-class drop/ex-rarest gates compare candidate to exact freshly refitted control on SAME one outer cut; primary objective stays all-class MacroF1.
numeric_judge.historical_comparison: Historical V11/V16/T5 reused-public results are context only; new outer partition/control refit is a different experiment. One cut is neither mean-of-two nor full CV/OOF/significance.
numeric_judge.failures: Any source/ID/dataflow/ownership/time/refit/procedure failure: outer metrics null with reason; never zero-impute. Partial numeric output retained explicitly unqualified, never whole success.

per_task_actual_fields: source/rowmap/original hash vector/dtypes/ordered feature+class schema/split producer SHA
operational_task_plan_instantiation.partition_binding_SHA: Canonical JSON hash of original train+outer positions+rowmap+raw featurehash/dtype/schema/producer+derived five input references. Equal index list alone is insufficient.
operational_task_plan_instantiation.still_missing: Actual inner array/split/spec provenance, independent control iteration/refit/CSV/class-proba/owner/algorithm-I/O semantics and once-only judge remain in final driver/auditor; function does not authorize label access.
